get_predictions.description: Get realtime predictions for the next trains, buses or boats at a stop, soonest first: route, destination, predicted arrival and departure, minutes away and any cancellation. No API key required.
get_predictions.name: get_predictions

parameters.description: The stop or station id, e.g. 'place-pktrm' for all of Park Street. Find ids with List stops.
parameters.name: stop

parameters.description: Only include this route id. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: route

parameters.description: Only include trips going one way. Each route names its two directions (see List routes). Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: direction_id

options.label: Direction 0 (e.g. southbound on the Red Line)
Direction 1 (e.g. northbound on the Red Line)

parameters.description: How many predictions to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: limit

count.description: How many predictions, soonest first came back.

arrival_time.description: Predicted arrival, ISO 8601 with offset. Empty at the first stop.

departure_time.description: Predicted departure, ISO 8601 with offset. Empty at the last stop.

direction_id.description: 0 or 1: which of the route's directions the trip runs in.

headsign.description: Where the trip is headed, as shown on the vehicle, e.g. 'Braintree'.

is_cancelled.description: True when the trip is cancelled or will skip this stop.

minutes_away.description: Minutes from now until it departs (or arrives, at the last stop).

schedule_relationship.description: Empty for a normal trip, else 'Added', 'Cancelled', 'Skipped' or 'No data'.

status.description: A status the MBTA shows instead of a time, e.g. 'Boarding' or 'Stopped 3 stops away'.

stop_id.description: The platform or stop id, e.g. '70075'.

trip_id.description: The MBTA's id for the trip.

vehicle_id.description: The id of the vehicle running the trip, when one is assigned.

stop.description: The stop id (or ids) the predictions are for.

list_alerts.description: List MBTA service alerts (delays, shuttles, station closures, elevator outages and notices), most severe first, optionally for one route, stop or kind of service, and only those in effect now. No API key required.

alerts.header: Braintree Station notice: Premium parking is available at this location. You can buy premium passes and permits using SpotHero.

list_alerts.name: list_alerts

parameters.description: Only include alerts for this route id.
parameters.name: route

parameters.description: Only include alerts for this stop or station id.
parameters.name: stop

parameters.description: Only include this kind of service. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: route_type

parameters.description: Only include alerts in effect right now, leaving out upcoming ones.
parameters.name: active_now

parameters.description: How many alerts to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

active_periods.description: The periods in which the alert applies.

end.description: When it ends, or empty while open-ended.

start.description: When the alert takes effect, ISO 8601 with offset.

affected_route_ids.description: Ids of the routes affected, e.g. ['Red'].

affected_stop_ids.description: Ids of the stations and stops affected.

created_at.description: When the alert was created, ISO 8601 with offset.

description.description: The details, e.g. affected stations and alternatives.

effect.description: What it does to service, e.g. 'Delay', 'Shuttle', 'Station closure' or 'Notice'.

header.description: The alert's headline, as riders see it.

service_effect.description: A one-line summary, e.g. 'Red Line delay'.

short_header.description: A shorter headline, when there is one.

timeframe.description: When, in words, e.g. 'ongoing' or 'this weekend'.

updated_at.description: When it was last updated, ISO 8601 with offset.

url.description: A page with more information, when the alert links one.

count.description: How many alerts, most severe first came back.

list_route_patterns.description: List the different ways an MBTA route's trips run (each branch, short turn and diversion) with where they go and how typical each is. No API key required.
list_route_patterns.display_str_template: List the patterns of MBTA route {0}.
list_route_patterns.name: list_route_patterns

parameters.description: The route id, e.g. 'Red' or '1'.
parameters.name: route

parameters.description: Only include trips going one way. Each route names its two directions (see List routes). Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: direction_id

options.label: Direction 0 (e.g. southbound on the Red Line)
Direction 1 (e.g. northbound on the Red Line)

count.description: How many route patterns, typical ones first came back.

route_patterns.description: The route patterns, typical ones first.

direction_id.description: 0 or 1: the direction it runs in.

headsign.description: The destination shown on its vehicles, e.g. 'Braintree'.

is_canonical.description: True for the route's standard path in this direction.

name.description: Where it runs from and to, e.g. 'Alewife - Braintree'.

time_description.description: When it runs, for one that only runs sometimes, e.g. 'Weekdays only'.

typicality.description: 1 typical, 2 deviation, 3 highly atypical, 4 diversion, 5 canonical only, 0 not defined.

list_routes.description: List the MBTA's routes (subway lines, Green Line branches, buses, commuter rail lines and ferries) with their colors and the names and destinations of their two directions. Filter by kind of service or by a stop to see what serves it. No API key required.
list_routes.name: list_routes

parameters.description: Only include this kind of service. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: route_type

parameters.description: Only include routes that serve this stop or station id. Leave empty for all routes.
parameters.name: stop

parameters.description: How many routes to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

count.description: How many routes, in the MBTA's own order came back.

routes.description: The routes, in the MBTA's own order.

color.description: The route's color as a hex code, e.g. '#DA291C'.

description.description: The MBTA's kind of route, e.g. 'Rapid Transit' or 'Key Bus'.

directions.description: The route's two directions, with where each one goes.

destination.description: Where trips this way end, e.g. 'Ashmont/Braintree'.

direction_id.description: 0 or 1: the value the Direction filters take.

name.description: What the direction is called, e.g. 'South' or 'Outbound'.

fare_class.description: The fare that applies, e.g. 'Rapid Transit' or 'Local Bus'.

id.description: The MBTA's route id, e.g. 'Red', 'Green-E' or '1'.

long_name.description: The long name, e.g. 'Red Line' or 'Harvard Square - Nubian Station'.

name.description: What riders call the route, e.g. 'Red Line' or 'Bus 1'.

route_type.description: Light rail, Subway, Commuter rail, Bus or Ferry.

short_name.description: The short name, e.g. '1' for a bus or 'E' for a branch.

text_color.description: The text color to use on the route color, e.g. '#FFFFFF'.

url.description: The route's schedule page on mbta.com.

list_schedules.description: List scheduled arrival and departure times at a stop or along a route for a day, optionally between two times of day, earliest first. No API key required.
list_schedules.name: list_schedules

parameters.description: The stop or station id. Give a stop, a route, or both.
parameters.name: stop

parameters.description: Only include this route id.
parameters.name: route

parameters.description: Only include trips going one way. Each route names its two directions (see List routes). Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: direction_id

options.label: Direction 0 (e.g. southbound on the Red Line)
Direction 1 (e.g. northbound on the Red Line)

parameters.description: The day to list, within the current timetable. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: service_date

parameters.description: Only include times from this time of day, e.g. 07:30 (Boston time).
parameters.name: min_time

parameters.description: Only include times up to this time of day, e.g. 09:00.
parameters.name: max_time

parameters.description: How many times to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

count.description: How many scheduled times, earliest first came back.

direction_id.description: 0 or 1: which of the route's directions the trip runs in.

drop_off.description: Whether riders can get off, in the same terms as pickup.

headsign.description: Where the trip is headed, as shown on the vehicle, e.g. 'Braintree'.

is_timepoint.description: True when the time is exact; false when it is an estimate between timed stops.

pickup.description: Whether riders can board: 'Regular', 'Not available', 'Phone the agency' or 'Ask the driver'.

stop_id.description: The platform or stop id, e.g. '70075'.

stop_sequence.description: Where this stop falls along the trip (it grows along the trip).

trip_id.description: The MBTA's id for the trip.

list_stops.description: List the stations along an MBTA route, or the stations and stops near a point (nearest first), with their ids, addresses, coordinates and wheelchair access. Use a stop id from here in Get predictions or List schedules. No API key required.

stops.address: Alewife Brook Pkwy and Cambridge Park Dr, Cambridge, MA 02140
stops.name: Alewife

list_stops.name: list_stops

parameters.description: List the stations on this route id. Give this, or a latitude and longitude, or both.
parameters.name: route

parameters.description: Find stops near this latitude (with longitude).
parameters.name: latitude

parameters.description: Find stops near this longitude (with latitude).
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.description: How far from the point to look, in miles. Defaults to 0.5.
parameters.name: radius_miles

parameters.description: How many stops to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

count.description: How many stations and stops came back.

address.description: The street address, when the MBTA lists one.

description.description: A fuller description, e.g. 'Park Street - Red Line - Alewife'.

id.description: The MBTA's stop id: 'place-pktrm' for a whole station, or a number such as '70075' for one platform or bus stop.

kind.description: 'station', 'stop' (a platform or bus stop), 'entrance', 'node' or 'boarding area'.

parent_station_id.description: For a platform or stop inside a station, that station's id.

platform_name.description: For a platform, which trains it serves, e.g. 'Alewife'.

vehicle_type.description: For a platform or stop, the kind of service that calls there.

wheelchair_accessible.description: True if accessible, false if not, empty when unknown.

list_vehicles.description: See where every vehicle on an MBTA route is right now: its position, the stop it is at or heading to, its destination and how full it is. No API key required.
list_vehicles.name: list_vehicles

parameters.description: The route id, e.g. 'Red' or '1'.
parameters.name: route

parameters.description: Only include trips going one way. Each route names its two directions (see List routes). Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: direction_id

options.label: Direction 0 (e.g. southbound on the Red Line)
Direction 1 (e.g. northbound on the Red Line)

parameters.description: How many vehicles to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

bearing.description: Heading in degrees clockwise from north.

carriage_count.description: How many cars the train has (0 when not reported).

current_status.description: 'Stopped at', 'Incoming at' or 'In transit to' the stop.

direction_id.description: 0 or 1: which of the route's directions the trip runs in.

headsign.description: Where the trip is headed, as shown on the vehicle, e.g. 'Braintree'.

in_revenue_service.description: True when it is carrying passengers.

label.description: The number on the vehicle (for a train, its lead car).

occupancy.description: How full it is, e.g. 'Many seats available', when reported.

speed_mps.description: Speed in meters per second, when reported.

stop_id.description: The stop the vehicle is at or heading to.

trip_id.description: The MBTA's id for the trip.

updated_at.description: When the position was reported, ISO 8601 with offset.

description: Boston's public transit from the MBTA: realtime predictions for the next train or bus at a stop, timetables, service alerts, live vehicle positions, and the routes and stops of the subway, Green Line, buses, commuter rail and ferries. No account or API key required.
